attributes.action: Stop the unlawful banning of cars from camp
attributes.additional_details: For years RDS have told use they can just ban cars as they please from camps (privately owned land) but according to JSP 800 defence & transport as well as army legal this is not the case !!
attributes.background: Stop the over reaching of RDS trying to ban privately owned cars from parking at SP’s place of work with no legal basis

rejection.details: We struggle to understand what it is exactly that you are calling for in this petition in relation to JSP 800.
